assets.subject: loose hay scattered on the floor
assets.detail: Loose golden hay and straw scattered thinly on the floor in a soft irregular patch with ragged, thinning, wispy edges, a few stray stalks. Seen from directly overhead, lying flat. About 60 in by 48 in. Variation 4: a different irregular outline and density. Show exactly this patch and nothing else.
